registry.coverage_note: A bounded manual registry of known cash-acquisition events, not a live news feed, exhaustive corporate-action screen, or clearance of unlisted stocks. Each event records its own source dates and manual review date. Unresolved events stay excluded after review_due and require a new source review; expected closing dates and go-shop deadlines never automatically clear a stock.

review_note.text: Re-reviewed 19 November 2026. Copart's release of 16 October 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000900075/000119312526423478/d129535dex991.htm, read as a search-result excerpt; page bytes not captured) says the acquisition completed and ACV's shares ceased trading, and the retained Nasdaq directory snapshots drop ACVA from 20 October 2026. The registry ends an entry only with a resolution carrying the SHA-256 of captured bytes, and none could be captured from this sandbox, so the entry stays listed and blocked with its review overdue. A stock that no longer trades prints no bars and can carry no ticket. To end it, capture the release from a network that reaches sec.gov and add the resolution.
